instruction: Store a key-value pair in Consul KV
output:
consul kv put redis/config/maxconn 100
Success! Data written to: redis/config/maxconn

instruction: Store a JSON value in Consul KV
output:
consul kv put app/config '{"host":"db1","port":5432,"ssl":true}'
Success! Data written to: app/config

instruction: Retrieve a value from Consul KV
output:
consul kv get redis/config/maxconn
100

instruction: Retrieve detailed metadata from Consul KV
output:
consul kv get -detailed redis/config/maxconn
CreateIndex      525
Flags            0
Key              redis/config/maxconn
LockIndex        0
ModifyIndex      525
Session          -
Value            100

instruction: List all keys under a Consul KV prefix
output:
consul kv list redis/
redis/config/maxconn
redis/config/timeout
redis/config/poolsize
redis/secrets/password

instruction: List only keys (no values) under a prefix
output:
consul kv get -keys redis/
redis/config/maxconn
redis/config/poolsize
redis/config/timeout
redis/secrets/password

instruction: Delete a single key from Consul KV
output:
consul kv delete redis/config/timeout
Success! Data deleted at key: redis/config/timeout

instruction: Delete all keys under a Consul KV prefix
output:
consul kv delete -prefix redis/
Success! Data deleted at prefix: redis/

instruction: Export Consul KV data to JSON
Import keys from JSON into Consul KV
output:
consul kv import "$(cat ./backup.json)"
Imported 5 keys from JSON

instruction: Watch a Consul KV key for changes
output:
consul watch -type key -key redis/config/maxconn
Old: 100
New: 200

Old: 200
New: 300

instruction: Watch Consul KV keys under a prefix
Watch Consul service health
Watch Consul for node changes
Watch Consul for service registration changes
Retrieve a binary value from Consul KV
output:
consul kv get -base64 app/config/secret
c3VwZXJfc2VjcmV0X3ZhbHVl

instruction: Store a value in Consul KV with explicit flags
output:
consul kv put -flags 42 app/config/debug true
Success! Data written to: app/config/debug

instruction: Check if a Consul KV key exists
output:
consul kv get app/config/missing-key
Error! No key exists at: app/config/missing-key

instruction: Retrieve keys with recursive prefix from Consul KV
output:
consul kv get -recurse app/
app/config: {"host":"db1"}
app/version: 3
app/debug: true
